posts.text:
The tech industry wants us to believe its products are inevitable and we have no ability to stop them. But that couldn’t be further from the truth.

It was great to chat with @thomas-dekeyser.bsky.social about how tech refusal is something we’ve done for hundreds of years — and continues today.
posts.summary: Argues tech products are not inevitable, advocates for tech refusal

posts.text:
Under Trump, the United States has made it clear that dependence on US tech can and will be weaponized.

In part, that's a new development — at least for some countries. But ensuring the power of the US was sustained by getting other parts of the world to adopt its tech was always part of the plan.
